description: Angular component for dynamic form rendering and management within the Thingsboard project, including form control setup, validation, and dynamic property handling.

classes.name: DynamicFormComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a dynamic form with validation, conditional display, and data binding.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and loads metadata.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, especially 'properties'.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for propagating value changes.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the form value from external source.

methods.name: loadMetadata
methods.description: Loads form properties, sets up controls, and validation rules.

methods.name: calculateControlsState
methods.description: Updates control states based on property conditions.

methods.name: updateControlsState
methods.description: Enables or disables controls based on visibility and conditions.

methods.name: setupValue
methods.description: Initializes form values and control states.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates changes.
